title: DaVinci MIQRO Mouthpiece – Extended & Flat
description:
Replacement mouthpiece for Davinci Miqro

Two types available:
Flat Mouthpiece: Having a spare, clean flat mouthpiece does come in handy. Made out of 100% zirconium ceramic, this mouthpiece allows you to draw the purest flavor on every session.

Extended Mouthpiece: This extended mouthpiece is designed with purity and discretion in mind, and is made of 100% zirconium ceramic, which is 20x stronger than glass. It can also double as a 10mm water adapter. Be sure to pick up an extra set to always have a clean one ready to go.
